title: New on Instagram: sends beat likes
hook:
Instagram keeps saying the same thing.
Sends matter more than likes.
caption:
Instagram keeps saying the same thing.
Sends matter more than likes.

In a Q&A in October, Mosseri said Instagram mostly looks for Reels and photos you'd send to someone. He's been saying versions of this for a while: watch time, sends and likes, each compared to how many people saw the post.

A fashion client said something that matches. People don't comment much anymore. They save, or they send it to a friend.

So when I look at a creator's past posts now, I check shares and saves before comments.

And in briefs I ask one simple thing: who would send this to whom? If nobody can answer, the video probably won't travel.

Follow Galvor for what's new on Instagram every Thursday.
